Opening Nomi on macOS for the first time

Builds are Developer ID signed but not yet Apple notarized. If Gatekeeper blocks first launch, click "Open Anyway" in System Settings → Privacy & Security, or run:

sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Nomi.app

Windows SmartScreen notice

After verifying the download came from official GitHub Releases, click "More info → Run anyway" on the SmartScreen prompt.

Linux install commands

Mark the AppImage executable before running, or install the .deb package with apt:

chmod +x Nomi-*.AppImage && ./Nomi-*.AppImage

Get started in 3 steps

  1. Launch Nomi and finish onboarding (optionally pick detected local CLIs).
  2. Connect a model once in Settings → Models & Agents, or start a local model.
  3. Open parallel agent sessions from the unified sidebar or Agent Board, or press Ctrl/⌘+K for commands.
